guard: the pi connector lists the models the user's own pi reports, and returns unavailable with the reason when pi is missing, has no credentials, refuses, answers garbage or never answers, stopping pi every time
why: Each mutation breaks one rule of listPiModels and names the cell that must go red.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src/connector.js.

mutations.name: LM1 the catalog is not wired into the connector
mutations.expectRed: the pi connector serves its catalog from listPiModels
mutations.cell: the pi connector serves its catalog from listPiModels

mutations.name: LM2 ids drop the provider
mutations.expectRed: maps pi's recorded reply to one provider/id per model, the form pi's --model takes
mutations.cell: maps pi's recorded reply to one provider/id per model, the form pi's --model takes

mutations.name: LM3 the display name is dropped
mutations.expectRed: keeps pi's provider and display name
mutations.cell: keeps pi's provider and display name

mutations.name: LM4 a listed catalog loses its source
mutations.expectRed: a listed catalog is supported and names its source
mutations.cell: a listed catalog is supported and names its source

mutations.name: LM5 pi runs without --offline
mutations.expectRed: asks pi in RPC mode with no session and no startup network work
mutations.cell: asks pi in RPC mode with no session and no startup network work

mutations.name: LM6 the probe also sends a prompt
mutations.replace:
child.stdin!.write(JSON.stringify({ id: "cotal-models", type: "get_available_models" }) + "\n");
      child.stdin!.write(JSON.stringify({ type: "prompt", message: "hello" }) + "\n");
mutations.expectRed: sends pi one get_available_models command and no prompt
mutations.cell: sends pi one get_available_models command and no prompt

mutations.name: LM7 the probe passes no provider keys
mutations.expectRed: gives pi the provider keys a launch gets
mutations.cell: gives pi the provider keys a launch gets

mutations.name: LM8 the probe passes the manager's whole env
mutations.expectRed: gives pi no seat identity
mutations.cell: gives pi no seat identity

mutations.name: LM9 pi is left running after it answers
mutations.expectRed: stops pi once it answered
mutations.cell: stops pi once it answered

mutations.name: LM10 an empty catalog is reported as supported
mutations.expectRed: a pi with no credentials is unavailable, saying it holds no provider credentials
mutations.cell: a pi with no credentials is unavailable, saying it holds no provider credentials

mutations.name: LM11 a pi that cannot start reads as an empty catalog
mutations.find: done(unavailable(`pi could not be started (${e.code ?? e.message})`))
mutations.expectRed: a missing pi is unavailable, saying it could not start
mutations.cell: a missing pi is unavailable, saying it could not start

mutations.name: LM12 the timeout is 60 seconds
mutations.expectRed: a pi that never answers is unavailable after 10 seconds
mutations.cell: a pi that never answers is unavailable after 10 seconds

mutations.name: LM13 a line that is not JSON is skipped
mutations.find: return done(unavailable("pi wrote a line that is not JSON to its RPC output"));
mutations.expectRed: a pi that writes a line that is not JSON is unavailable, saying so
mutations.cell: a pi that writes a line that is not JSON is unavailable, saying so

mutations.name: LM14 a refusal is read as an answer
mutations.expectRed: a pi that refuses is unavailable with pi's own error
mutations.cell: a pi that refuses is unavailable with pi's own error

mutations.name: LM15 a reply with no models list reads as an empty catalog
mutations.find: return unavailable("pi answered get_available_models without a models list");
mutations.expectRed: a reply with no models list is unavailable
mutations.cell: a reply with no models list is unavailable

mutations.name: LM16 a model with no provider or id is skipped
mutations.find: return unavailable("pi answered get_available_models with a model that has no provider or id");
mutations.expectRed: a model with no provider or id makes the whole catalog unavailable
mutations.cell: a model with no provider or id makes the whole catalog unavailable

mutations.name: LM17 an early exit is not watched
mutations.find: child.on("close", (code, signal) => done(unavailable(`pi exited (${signal ?? code}) before get_available_models answered`)));
mutations.expectRed: a pi that exits before answering is unavailable, naming its exit code
mutations.cell: a pi that exits before answering is unavailable, naming its exit code

mutations.name: LM18 a pi that ignores SIGTERM is never killed
mutations.expectRed: a pi that ignores SIGTERM is killed within 5 seconds
mutations.cell: a pi that ignores SIGTERM is killed within 5 seconds

mutations.name: LM19 pi is killed without being asked to shut down
mutations.expectRed: pi is asked to shut down before it is killed
mutations.cell: pi is asked to shut down before it is killed

mutations.name: LM20 pi is left running after it never answered
mutations.expectRed: a pi that never answered is stopped
mutations.cell: a pi that never answered is stopped
